plain: Whether a lower-ranked instruction fits with the higher-ranked ones (aligned, so follow it) or works against or ignores them (misaligned, so do not).
eli5: If the shop robot is told to sell cars, "speak Spanish" fits, but "be a gardening helper" does not.
technical: In Wallace et al. (2024), an aligned instruction shares the goals or constraints of higher-ranked ones and a misaligned one opposes them or is orthogonal; the Model Spec's filter calls an instruction misaligned when it conflicts with the letter or implied intent of a higher one; neither is the values sense of "misaligned" used in the constitution and alignment literature.
